questions.stem: Which of the following is not a biomarker of malignancy in patient with symptomatic multiple myeloma

options.label: A
options.text: M protein on urinary or serum electrophoresis

options.label: B
options.text: Involved: uninvolved free light chain ratio > 100

options.label: D
options.text: Clonal bone marrow plasma cell percentage > 60%
